findings.finding: Euronext's own September volume tables show a strong Q3 2026 against Q3 2025: cash value ADV EUR13.7bn (+21.8%), MTS cash ADV +80.4%, MTS repo +6.2%, commodity derivatives ADV +32.4%, FX spot ADV +26.1%, Nord Pool intraday +40.4%, individual-equity futures +99%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (volume-driven beat, revenue +3% vs FactSet) +6.16% on 2026-07-31; Q1 2026 +5.20% on 2026-05-20; Q3 2025 +3.93% on 2025-11-07 (Yahoo daily closes)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the tables were published on 7 Oct and the 16 Oct consensus came after them. If the quarter were not priced, the consensus would sit near the Q2 level. It sits at EUR528.6m against Q2's EUR544.4m, only 3% lower QoQ where last year fell 6%, so analysts have absorbed the volumes. What is left is how they translate into revenue capture (Athex consolidation, MTS mix), which is small.
findings.independence: JPMorgan's above-consensus EBITDA call points the same way: https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/jpmorgan-place-euronext-sur-sa-liste-positive-catalyst-watch_704505

findings.finding: JPMorgan expects Q3 adjusted EBITDA of EUR358m, about 4% above consensus, mainly on a strong Athens contribution (the company-compiled consensus is EUR343.9m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: EBITDA beats were bought: Q2 2026 EUR360m vs EUR330.6m FactSet, stock +6%, a record high (https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/euronext-au-plus-haut-historique-grace-a-des-resultats-records_700834)
findings.original_quote: La banque s'attend à un excédent brut d'exploitation (Ebitda) ajusté de 358 millions d'euros au troisième trimestre. (The bank expects adjusted EBITDA of EUR358m in the third quarter.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. It is a wire item (Agefi-Dow Jones) and the stock moved from ~169.8 to a record 177.6 by 30 Oct before giving it back on the CEO news. A whisper above consensus is the market's expectation, so a print of exactly EUR358m would be roughly in line with the whisper. What remains is the chance that the beat is the same size as Q1 and Q2 (Q2 beat EBITDA by 9%).
findings.independence: The company's own volume tables (finding 1), which are a different document: https://live.euronext.com/sites/default/files/statistics/ir/euronext_latest_month_volumes.xlsx

findings.finding: Management said on the Q2 call that revised 2026 cost guidance would come in November and would factor in AI-driven efficiencies, so this release carries a guidance change on costs, which JPMorgan expects to come down from the ~EUR770m guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: the cost guide was cut to EUR660m from EUR670m together with a EUR250m buyback, stock +3.93%. Q2 2026: cost guide kept, costs EUR184.4m vs EUR190m expected, stock +6%
findings.why_not_priced: The direction is expected (JPM: 'revoie à la baisse ses prévisions de coûts'), so only the size is unpriced. Deutsche Bank called a revision 'a matter of time' after H1. If the market had priced a large cut, the stock would have held the record 177.6 rather than giving back 4.5% into the print. The range is wide because a small trim against an expected cut could read as a disappointment.

findings.finding: A new share buyback is expected with the Q3 release (JPMorgan EUR250m for Q4 2026-Q1 2027, Jefferies about EUR300m or more), backed by 1.3x net debt/EBITDA at the low end of the 1-2x target, as in Q3 2025 when a EUR250m programme came with the results.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 results plus EUR250m buyback: +3.93% on 2025-11-07
findings.original_quote: JPMorgan pense que la société pourrait annoncer un programme de rachat d'actions de 250 millions d'euros. (JPMorgan thinks the company could announce a EUR250m share buyback programme; source https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/jpmorgan-place-euronext-sur-sa-liste-positive-catalyst-watch_704505. The Jefferies EUR300m+ call is from the 31 Jul ABC Bourse article, read only as a summary.)
findings.why_not_priced: The expectation is public, so a EUR250-300m programme is roughly priced. The unpriced part is the upside (leverage room after the Athex share-exchange deal, possibly a special return) against the downside of a smaller or no programme while M&A optionality is kept (Oddo: flexibility kept for an M&A scenario; Boujnah has floated Deutsche Börse). That is two-sided, with a small positive tilt from the leverage headroom.

findings.finding: On 2 Nov Euronext named an external CEO successor, David Knibbe of NN Group, to take over from Boujnah at the May 2027 AGM. The stock fell 3.5% that day. The Q3 call is the first at which management takes questions on the transition, strategic continuity and the M&A posture.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-11-02: -3.5% (177.6 -> 171.4, Yahoo daily closes) on the announcement
findings.original_quote: Euronext ... proposer la nomination de David Knibbe au poste de directeur général ... Stéphane Boujnah ... quitter ces mêmes fonctions en mai prochain (Euronext will propose David Knibbe as chief executive; Stéphane Boujnah leaves those roles next May)
findings.why_not_priced: The announcement is priced (-3.5% on the day). What is left is the risk of a cautious lame-duck tone, with no target upgrade and capital allocation deferred to the new CEO. The 4.5% drawdown from the record could equally set up a relief rebound, which is why the size is small and the range two-sided.
findings.independence: Milano Finanza had flagged an internal frontrunner (CFO Giorgio Modica), which makes the external pick a surprise: https://www.milanofinanza.it/news/tre-candidati-per-il-dopo-boujnah-in-euronext-2717243

lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the Q3 volumes are public company data, so finding 1 went from +0.4 to +0.2 and finding 2 (a wire preview built on the same volumes) from +0.6 to +0.4
'The move is in the guide': the flagged cost-guidance revision is a scheduled guidance event, so abs_move_pct went from 4.5 to 5.5 and the guidance finding from +0.7 to +0.8

'Let the reaction history move p_up, not abs_move_pct': four straight positive results-day reactions kept p_up at 58 rather than raising it, because the positives are previewed; abs_move_pct is not capped at those reactions
